title: "Heavenly Secrets Manifest"
next_chapter_hook: "The moment Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, that aged voice from the depths of the Tianji Record sounded once more—and this time, it brought not guidance, but a warning: 'Your chess game has been observed.'"

text.content: "The Jade Slip trembled in his palm, and a torrent of information crashed into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a breached flood. He dropped to one knee, hands gripping the Jade Slip so tightly his temples throbbed, large beads of sweat dripping from his jaw onto the Blue Stone floor, instantly evaporating into wisps of white smoke.\n\nThe third page of the Tianji Record—fully revealed."

"'Congratulations, child.' The aged voice did not come from his father's remnant soul, but from a name Chen Ji had never expected—Mo Xiansheng. That existence that had guarded the Tianji Record in remnant soul form now manifested as a illusory figure within Chen Ji's Mental Sea.\n\n'You now possess the ability to foresight within three hours, but the price... you should understand.'"

dialogue.content: 'Every foresight consumes five points of Heavenly Fate. If you forcibly peer beyond the scope of your ability—' Mo Xiansheng's illusion paused slightly, 'the backlash will multiply exponentially.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly stood, his eyes flashing with brilliance. His Heavenly Fate was nearly depleted, but if he could use this to rewrite the impending Deadly Ground...\n\nHe drew a deep breath and immersed his consciousness into the third page of the Tianji Record. In an instant, images three hours ahead flashed before his eyes like a carousel—Holy Sect ambush, Han Lie's pursuit, and a vague yet lethal figure."

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record revealed the crisis foresight three hours ahead—Holy Sect ambush, Xuanwu Sect Han Lie's chase, and a lethal figure concealed by Heavenly Fate's power. Chen Ji faces a crucial decision:"

choices.description: "Forcefully peer at more details, consuming extra Heavenly Fate, but obtain complete ambush routes and enemy formations."

text.content: "Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his consciousness like a blade piercing through the blurred veil of fate. Intense headache struck, blood flowing from his nostrils, staining half his garment. But the images gradually sharpened—seven from the Holy Sect, Han Lie leading thirty-two disciples from the Xuanwu Sect, and that lethal figure... was actually Ling Yuan!"

choices.description: "Only acquire basic foresight information, without consuming extra Heavenly Fate. Intelligence may be incomplete but safe."

text.content: "Chen Ji suppressed his greed, merely touching the prophetic veil lightly with his will. The images were blurred but sufficient to see—the Holy Sect and Xuanwu Sect's joint encirclement, at least dozens coming. He sneered, having already calculated his plan."

"Foresight ended. Chen Ji opened his eyes abruptly, the afterglow of fate's trajectory lingering in his pupils' depths. He wiped away the nosebleed, his gaze as deep as an ancient well. Three hours... enough.\n\nHe took out the communication Jade Talisman, transmitting to Ye Qing: 'Plan changed. The abandoned Spiritual Mine thirty li southeast, see you in half an hour.'"

dialogue.content: "A moment later, Ye Qing's figure appeared before Chen Ji like a specter, Demonic Path mist swirling around her, concealing every trace of presence. She frowned slightly: 'You summoned me so urgently—what happened?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji shared the foresight images through divine consciousness with Ye Qing, watching her pupils constrict, a faint smile curling at his lips: 'The Holy Sect and Xuanwu Sect are joining forces to eliminate me, and that old fox Ling Yuan is probably pulling strings behind the scenes.'\n\nHe paused, tone light: 'But, it doesn't matter.'"

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing stared at him for several breaths, then suddenly laughed lightly: 'You're quite composed. That's a joint force of two Sects, nearly a hundred people—how do you plan to break through?'\n\nChen Ji raised three fingers: 'Only three steps needed. First, make them wait in the wrong place; second, make the people they wait for not be us; and third—'"

choice.prompt: "When Chen Ji explained the plan to Ye Qing, he displayed meticulous strategizing ability. Ye Qing's trust in him increased, but Chen Ji still needed to make a crucial decision:"

choices.text: "Let Ye Qing participate in encircling and killing Han Lie"
choices.description: "Utilize Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist and Combat Power to counter-ambush and kill Han Lie, greatly boosting morale but higher risk."

dialogue.content: "A gleam of surprise flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, then transformed into appreciation: 'You dare to think big. However—I like it.' The demonic mist around her thickened by three degrees, 'I've never faced Han Lie directly before.'"

choices.text: "Have Ye Qing only cover the retreat"
choices.description: "Ye Qing only uses Demonic Path mist to conceal their aura and help Chen Ji escape, preserving strength but missing the chance to kill Han Lie."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing nodded slightly: 'Conservative but prudent. If those Holy Sect fools扑了个空, they'd be hopping mad.' She shifted her tone, 'But when that idiot Han Lie is alone next time, don't show mercy.'"

text.content: "Half an hour later, the southeast abandoned Spiritual Mine.\n\nChen Ji and Ye Qing hid within a secluded rocky cave, Demonic Path mist isolating their auras completely. And at the preset ambush point thirty li away, the combined forces of Holy Sect and Xuanwu Sect had all taken position—only, their intended target had yet to appear."

"'What the hell!' Han Lie slammed his fist into the rock wall, debris scattering. His arrogant face was filled with agitation and disbelief, 'The intelligence clearly said he'd take this road!'

A Xuanwu Sect disciple cautiously approached: 'Senior Brother, could the intelligence be wrong...'

'Waste!' Han Lie kicked him away, 'Keep waiting! I don't believe he dares not come!'"

"Meanwhile, deep in the Spiritual Mine, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, a faint smile playing at his lips.

Through the residual connection of the Tianji Record, he clearly 'saw' everything over there—Han Lie's fury, the Holy Sect disciples' whispers, and that pair of turbid old eyes that had never shown themselves but had been watching all along.

Ling Yuan."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing moved closer, noticing the blood at the corner of his mouth, frowning: 'Backlash struck?'\n\nChen Ji casually wiped away the blood, smiling carelessly: 'Small matter. Just five points of Heavenly Fate—I'm still holding up.'"

text.content:
"Before the words finished, a sharp pain surged from the depths of his four limbs and hundred bones. Chen Ji's body swayed, a mouthful of blood spraying out, staining the Blue Stone before him. He supported himself with one hand on the ground, knuckles white, cold sweat dripping from his temples.

The Tianji Record's backlash was more violent than anticipated.

And at this moment, he faintly sensed something... was watching him."

dialogue.content: "Deep within the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly. He gazed toward somewhere in the Void, his aged voice carrying a trace of worry: 'It... has noticed you, child. From now on, every step you take will be under the watch of those eyes.'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji slowly straightened, wiping the blood from his lips. He gazed toward where Han Lie was raging thirty li away, a derisive arc curling at his lips.

'Han Lie, Han Lie, you think setting up an inescapable net can capture me?' His voice was soft, yet carried unmistakable mockery, 'The next time we meet, I'll let you know—what true crushing feels like.'

In the distance, Han Lie suddenly shivered, though he knew not why."

"Ye Qing watched this man who kept spitting blood yet smiled as if it were nothing more than clouds, a complex glint flickering in her eyes.

This man, merely an Outer Disciple/Servant, not even having broken through Foundation Building, yet could stroll through the combined encirclement of two Sects, making the enemy wait foolishly for three hours.

She suddenly understood why the Holy Sect would pursue him at any cost.

And why—she chose to cooperate with him."

"Three hours later, the ambush circle finally dispersed.

Han Lie led the Xuanwu Sect disciples back in frustration, while the Holy Sect people vanished into the night with dark faces. They never imagined their meticulously planned certain-kill trap had been crystal clear to the target from the very start.

In this silent game of chess, Chen Ji achieved complete victory.

But he understood even more clearly—this was merely the calm before the storm. Since that old fox Ling Yuan had made his move, the next strike would be thunderous. And the Heavenly Eye's gaze... made everything more treacherous.

He looked up at the night sky, starlight reflected in his eyes.

'Come then,' he murmured softly, 'Chen Ji... will take the hit.'"

choice.prompt: "After successfully evading the ambush, Chen Ji faces a new decision. The sharp drop in Heavenly Fate has drawn the Heavenly Eye's attention. He must decide his next course of action:"

choices.text: "Immediately seek methods to restore Heavenly Fate"
choices.description: "Immediately investigate Heavenly Fate restoration methods. May require exploring ancient ruins or finding special spiritual medicines."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice适时响起: 'The scroll mentioned that Heavenly Fate can be restored by 'Heavenly Fate Objects'. Within the ancient ruins 'Wheel of Reincarnation Palace', there may be clues.'"

choices.description: "Temporarily take no action. Continue acting as a废物, avoiding attracting more attention."

text.content: "Ye Qing looked at him thoughtfully: 'You can endure indeed. But... in your current state, can you really hold out until the next foresight?'\n\nChen Ji gave no answer, merely gazing toward the Tianqing Sect direction, a meaningful gleam flickering in his eyes."

"Tianqing Sect, Sect Master's Hall.

Ling Yuan sat枯寂 on his meditation cushion, his turbid old eyes gazing toward the southeast. A moment later, he received news of the ambush failure.

'Failed?' His voice held not a trace of emotional fluctuation, 'That brat Han Lie is indeed trash.'

He closed his eyes, fingers gently tapping the armrest. Suddenly, he smiled—that smile was sinister and bizarre.

'But that's fine. The more this way... the more interesting it becomes for this old man.'"

"Just as Ling Yuan revealed his sinister smile, subtle changes occurred deep within the Tianji Record.

On the fourth page of that ancient scroll, the originally blurred runes began slowly emerging—only a corner, yet already emanating a chilling aura.

Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly sounded, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'The fourth page... is beginning to awaken. It is responding to the way you use Heavenly Secrets.'

Chen Ji opened his eyes abruptly, his pupils reflecting the mysterious light flowing across the scroll.

This meant—greater power was awakening.

And more terrifyingly, greater backlash was also on its way."
